THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS DAY, JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE CHILLAKUR SUMALATHA  ORAL JUDGMENT Heard Ms.Pavana who represents Sri.Pratheep.K.C. learned counsel on record for the appellant.
Also heard Sri.Ravi S Samprathi learned counsel for respondent No.2.
2.
Being aggrieved by the sum that is awarded as compensation towards damages caused to his vehicle, the appellant is before this Court.

The appellant challenges the order that is rendered by the Additional Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Udupi in MVC No.277/2018 dated 03.07.2020.
3.

entities.text: Additional Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Udupi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: On the ground that her vehicle bearing registration No.KA-20-MA-5650 got totally damaged in a road traffic accident, the appellant claimed a sum of Rs.2,08,394/- as compensation.

The version of the appellant is that a sum of Rs.3,14,153/- is required for getting the vehicle repaired as NC:
2024:KHC:45652 per the estimation given.
However, Ex.P13 report of the surveyor goes to show that the declared value of the vehicle is Rs.2,00,000/- and wreck value is Rs.25,000/-.
Considering the evidence produced, the Tribunal awarded a sum of Rs.1,25,000/- for the loss sustained by the appellant due to damages caused to the vehicle.
4. The submission that is made by Ms.Pavana is that the Tribunal ought to have awarded the sum claimed.
5. Per contra, the submission of Sri.Ravi S Samprathi is that the vehicle was totally damaged and till now it is not subjected for any repairs.
Learned counsel also states that the sum awarded by the Tribunal was deposited.
However, the appellant till now did not spend that money for the repairs of the vehicle.
6. Having considered the totality of evidence produced, this Court is of the view that the sum granted by the Tribunal towards damages i.e., Rs.1,25,000/- is highly justifiable.
This Court does not find any grounds whatsoever to interfere with the findings given by the Tribunal regarding entitlement of the appellant towards damages.

Resultantly, the appeal stands dismissed without costs.
